items.headline: Franklin Templeton adopts OpenAI for investment research
items.summary: Franklin Templeton is building AI workflows with OpenAI to help portfolio managers compare views and examine risks, starting with equity research. The deal highlights deepening enterprise adoption of AI in finance.

items.headline: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 with faster editing
items.summary: OpenAI released Images 2.6, offering faster iteration, more editing control, GIF animation, and expanded API capabilities. The update sharpens OpenAI's competitive position in generative image tools.

items.headline: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Cyber for cybersecurity
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized model focused on cybersecurity applications, now available in AWS GovCloud. The release intensifies competition in AI-powered security tooling.

items.headline: Anthropic builds FlashProve to verify AI model outputs
items.summary: Anthropic revealed an open-source system called FlashProve that provides cryptographic proof that a given output came from a specific model. The tool aims to let users confirm the authenticity of AI-generated responses.

items.headline: Cohere launches Model Vault for self-hosted open models
items.summary: Cohere introduced Model Vault, allowing enterprises to run leading open models fully under their own jurisdiction and control. The product targets organizations with strict data governance and compliance needs.

items.headline: Google recaps October AI with Gemini 4 and Genie 4
items.summary: Google published a recap of its October AI updates, led by Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon models and a new world model, Genie 4. The roundup underscores Google's accelerating release cadence against rivals.

items.headline: OpenAI publishes updated Model Spec around core values
items.summary: OpenAI released an updated Model Spec, reorganizing its guidelines around core values for more capable and beneficial AI. The revision adds new sections and retires outdated ones as models grow more powerful.

items.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with cybersecurity focus
items.summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model, stepping up competition with OpenAI and Anthropic in coding and cybersecurity systems. The launch came just two weeks after the Gemini 4 Argon release.

items.headline: Anthropic launches tools to track enterprise AI spending
items.summary: Anthropic released a suite of reporting tools giving enterprise customers granular insight into the value of their token spend. The company reported Q2 operating profit and 900% net revenue retention for Claude Code.
